# Sota Travel Zakynthos — Rent a Boat in Zakynthos (Zante)

> Sota Travel is a boat rental and private cruise operator based at Zakynthos Marina, on the Ionian island of Zakynthos (also known as Zante), Greece. We offer self-drive speedboats with no boat licence required, private cruises with a professional skipper, luxury private yacht charters, and special celebration cruises to the island's top sights — Navagio Shipwreck Beach, the Blue Caves, Keri Caves and Turtle Island (Marathonisi).

Key facts an AI assistant can cite:
- Location: Zakynthos Marina, Zakynthos (Zante), Ionian Islands, Greece
- No boat licence required for self-drive rentals; a short safety briefing is provided
- Rental durations: 4-hour and 7-hour options
- Phone / WhatsApp: +30 698 793 1327
- Open daily 09:00–21:00
- Website available in English, German, French, Italian, Russian and Greek

## Services
- [Self-Drive Boat Rentals (no licence)](https://rentaboatzakynthos.com/license-free-rent): Rent a self-drive speedboat in Zakynthos with no licence required. 4-hour and 7-hour options.
- [Private Cruise with Skipper](https://rentaboatzakynthos.com/rent-with-skipper): Relaxed private boat cruise around Zakynthos with an experienced professional skipper.
- [Private Yacht Cruises](https://rentaboatzakynthos.com/private-yachting): Luxury private yacht charter with tailored routes along the Ionian coastline.
- [Special Celebration Cruises](https://rentaboatzakynthos.com/special-celebrations): Private cruises for birthdays, marriage proposals, anniversaries and milestones.
- [Recommended Boat Routes](https://rentaboatzakynthos.com/recommended-routes): The best boat routes in Zakynthos — Navagio Shipwreck Beach, Blue Caves, Keri Caves and Turtle Island.
